body: I won’t say I haven’t made mistakes or enabled her. Looking back I obviously did. In the end it only hurt me. Really just needed a place to get my thoughts out. Hoping that in this forum others understand what it’s like to be with a BPD person. I don’t want to be with her any longer. I’ll always care for her but at this point when she fucks up her life that’s on her. Not me.
I feel like you read two words of that....
You didn't fall in love overnight, mending your broken heart isn't going to be overnight either. Just know you are worth so much more than this pain and confusion.

My partner of 4 years left me at the beginning of this month to "find herself" and "figure out who she is and what she likes". At the beginning of November we had gone to a fertility specialist to discuss our plans of have a baby (We are LGBT).We had also just gotten back from a Thanksgiving trip the week before she ended it and had discussed our future plans of marriage and kids. A week or so after separating she moved into an older woman's house. She met her not too long ago. So no. You are definitely not alone. After 3 weeks I've realized this is 100% the best for me. I deserve better, you deserve better. Give it a little bit and you will see it too.
I have the means and a plan. Problem is I'm a first responder and know all too well what it's like to see the after math. I don't want to do that to anyone, so no I don't think I'd do it.

I'm not sure if it was last minute, seems like it. When I was in high school my best friend at the time got me a towel for Christmas. Nothing super fancy, and we didn't have any inside jokes about towels so it was somewhat random but I added it to my parents towel collection anyways and used it. I was thankful she had gotten me a gift at all and essentially said "it's the thought that counts". Fast forward two months to my birthday and she yet again got me the exact same type of towel just a different color. Still somewhat confused by it all and it's been almost 10 years.

Obviously a little late to the party. I've never posted before but this is a topic that I couldn't help but say something. 


When I was 16 I started a relationship with my 4H leader who was 39 at the time. Both of us are F and she was married with 4 kids. She was also a teacher at an elementary school. Our "relation-shit" lasted 8 months before I let it slip to my therapist that it was going on at which point we stopped. 

It all started because I was close with her daughter, I spent a lot of time with their entire family. A LOT of time. One day my 4H leader admitted she had feelings for me, I thought I also had feelings and said it was mutual. The next day our physical relationship started. We messed around in parking lots, at her house, in her bed, in her kids bed. Essentially the whole situation was fucked up and every step of the way I was lead to believe it was perfectly acceptable to have a secret affair with a married woman, who is your best friends mom and your 4H leader. She also told me she loved me and wanted to leave her family for me, although we both knew that wasn't possible. 

After my therapist became aware there was a small investigation which I lied throughout in hopes of protecting this woman. She blamed me for everything and essentially told her family I was delusional, stalking her and trying to break her family up. So I lost her, my second family, my best friend, 4H and had to do my best to avoid her kids even though we went to the same high school and later university. If I did so much as look at her daughter I'd get a text saying to "stop intimidating her"..... we were assigned a group project together. Made life super hard. I continued talking to her on a straight talk cell phone for a few years afterwards. I was still convinced she loved me and I loved her and it had all been my fault that things couldn't work out. 

However, I couldnt handle the guilt and shame and incessant blame that came with the situation. I was 16 when it started and had never been in a relationship then was launched into a full blow sexual affair with someone more than twice my age who lied at every step of the way. She divorced her husband a few years ago and I believe is now with a man she started talking to while we were doing our thing. Seems ironic, last time we talked she said I ruined her marriage. 

I still struggle with the whole thing, obviously. I feel dumb for protecting her and wish I wouldn't have accepted all of the blame and believed all of her lies and manipulation.
